name: API Testing with Postman
certifications: ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE)

beginner.summary: For manual testers, developers and analysts starting API testing with Postman. Covers HTTP and REST for testers, sending requests, collections, variables and environments, authorisation, writing tests with pm.test, JSON and schema validation, pre-request scripts, chaining requests, data-driven runs, negative testing, CRUD workflows, mock servers, documentation, Newman and the Postman CLI, GraphQL, the Postman console and sharing work in workspaces.
prerequisites: Understands what a web application does from the user's side
Basic JavaScript is helpful but not required
Can install desktop software or use the Postman web app
outcomes: Send and organise API requests in collections with variables and environments
Write Postman tests that check status, headers, bodies and JSON schemas
Build data-driven and chained API test flows including negative cases
Run collections from the command line and share work through workspaces

days.topic: Postman Overview, Workspaces and API Testing Setup
subtopics: What API testing is and why it matters
Postman desktop app and web app
The request builder and response viewer
Importing a collection or an OpenAPI file
Sending a first request to a public API
days.lab_task: Set up Postman, create a team workspace, import the course API's OpenAPI file, send five requests and save them in a collection.
days.deliverable: Workspace with an imported API and a first collection
checks: The OpenAPI file creates a collection of requests
Requests are saved in named folders

days.topic: HTTP for API Testers: Requests, Responses and Status Codes
subtopics: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE
Status code families and common codes
days.lab_task: Send each method to the course API, record the status codes and headers returned, cause four different error codes on purpose and explain each.
days.deliverable: Method and status code worksheet
checks: Each method is sent with the correct body or none
Four error codes are triggered and explained
Content type and caching headers are identified

days.topic: Sending Requests: Parameters, Bodies and Headers in Postman
subtopics: Request bodies: raw JSON, form data and URL encoded
Request settings such as redirects and timeouts
days.lab_task: Build requests that search with query parameters, create a resource with a JSON body, upload a file with form data and save example responses for each.
days.deliverable: Requests with saved examples
checks: Search results change with the query parameters
JSON and form data requests are accepted
Each request has a saved example response

days.topic: Collections and Folders
days.lab_task: Organise twenty requests into a collection with folders for users, products and orders, add descriptions, set collection-level authorisation and export the collection.
days.deliverable: Organised and documented collection
checks: Requests are grouped into feature folders
Requests inherit authorisation from the collection
The exported file imports cleanly into a new workspace

days.topic: Variables and Environments
subtopics: Variable scopes: global, collection, environment, data and local
Environments for dev, test and staging
Using {{variables}} in URLs, headers and bodies
days.lab_task: Create dev and test environments with base URLs and credentials, replace hard-coded values in the collection with variables and run the same requests against both environments.
days.deliverable: Environment files and a variable-driven collection
checks: No request contains a hard-coded host or token
The same requests pass against both environments
Sensitive values are marked secret and not shared as initial values

days.topic: Authorisation: API Keys, Basic, Bearer Tokens and OAuth 2.0
subtopics: API keys in headers or query strings
Inheriting authorisation from collections and folders
days.lab_task: Configure API key, basic, bearer and OAuth 2.0 authorisation for different endpoints, test each role's access and check the API's response to missing and expired tokens.
days.deliverable: Auth-configured collection with access tests
checks: Each auth type works on its endpoint
Each role gets allowed and forbidden responses correctly
Missing and expired tokens return 401 or 403

days.topic: Writing Tests with pm.test and pm.expect
subtopics: The Scripts tab: pre-request and post-response
Test results in the response pane
days.lab_task: Add tests to ten requests that check status, content type, response time and key fields in the JSON body, and make one test fail on purpose to read the result.
days.deliverable: Collection with post-response tests
checks: Every request checks status and content type
Key fields are asserted with pm.expect
The failing test's message identifies the problem

days.topic: Validating JSON Responses and Schemas
subtopics: Reusing schemas from the OpenAPI definition
days.lab_task: Write JSON Schemas for the user and order responses, validate them in tests, then change the API sample to break the schema and confirm the test catches it.
days.deliverable: Schema tests for two resources
checks: A broken field type fails the schema test
Array lengths and item types are checked

days.topic: Pre-Request Scripts and Dynamic Data
subtopics: Generating timestamps, IDs and random data
days.lab_task: Generate unique emails and order references with pre-request scripts, compute a request signature header and move shared scripts to the collection level.
days.deliverable: Collection with pre-request scripts
checks: Each run creates unique emails and references
The signed request is accepted by the API
Shared logic lives at collection level

days.topic: Chaining Requests: Passing Data Between Requests
subtopics: Why requests depend on each other
Using saved values in later requests
Chained flows for create, read, update and delete
days.lab_task: Build a chained flow that logs in, creates an order, reads it, updates it and deletes it, passing the token and order ID between requests, and run it end to end.
days.deliverable: Chained flow that runs end to end
checks: Token and order ID are passed through variables
The flow passes in the Collection Runner
The created order is deleted at the end

days.topic: Collection Runner and Data-Driven Tests with CSV and JSON
subtopics: Data files in CSV and JSON
days.lab_task: Run a sign-up request with a CSV file of twenty rows including valid, boundary and invalid data with expected status codes, and export the results.
days.deliverable: Data file, data-driven tests and exported results
checks: Each row runs as an iteration
Each iteration checks its expected status from the file

days.topic: Negative Testing: Errors, Validation and Edge Cases
subtopics: Why negative tests find the most bugs
days.lab_task: Write twenty negative tests for the order API covering missing fields, wrong types, boundaries, unknown IDs and duplicates, and report any responses that leak internal details.
days.deliverable: Negative test folder and a defect list
checks: Error responses follow the documented format
Responses with stack traces or internal details are reported

days.topic: Testing CRUD Workflows End to End
subtopics: Create, read, update and delete as a lifecycle
days.lab_task: Test the full lifecycle of a product with state checks after each step, test pagination and sorting on the list endpoint, and try two concurrent updates.
days.deliverable: CRUD workflow folder with lifecycle tests
checks: Each step verifies the stored state
Pagination and sorting behave as documented
The concurrent update result is recorded and explained

days.topic: Mock Servers for Testing Without a Back End
subtopics: Why mock servers help testers and front-end teams
Creating a mock server from a collection
Keeping mocks in step with the API
days.lab_task: Create a mock server for an API that is not built yet, add success and error examples, point an environment at the mock and run the collection's tests against it.
days.deliverable: Mock server and a mock environment
checks: The mock returns the saved examples
Error examples are returned for chosen requests
The collection runs against the mock environment
objectives: Test before the back end exists

days.topic: API Documentation in Postman
subtopics: Keeping docs in step with tests
Documentation for internal and external users
days.lab_task: Write descriptions for the collection, folders and five key requests with examples, publish the documentation and review it for gaps against the real API behaviour.
days.deliverable: Published documentation and a review list
checks: The collection, folders and key requests have descriptions
The documentation is viewable by the team
Gaps between docs and behaviour are listed

days.topic: Running Collections from the Command Line with Newman and Postman CLI
subtopics: Why run from the command line
newman run with environments and data files
days.lab_task: Export the collection and environment, run them with Newman and the Postman CLI, produce an HTML report and add the run to a GitHub Actions workflow that fails on test failures.
days.deliverable: Command-line runs, HTML report and CI workflow
checks: The collection runs with the environment and data file
A failing test fails the workflow
objectives: Run collections from the command line

days.topic: Testing GraphQL APIs in Postman
subtopics: Partial data and the errors array
days.lab_task: Import a GraphQL schema, write queries and mutations with variables, test successful responses and errors, and compare how errors are reported with the REST API.
days.deliverable: GraphQL request set with tests
checks: Queries and mutations return expected data
Errors are checked in the errors array
Differences from REST testing are listed

days.topic: Debugging with the Postman Console
subtopics: A debugging routine for failing requests
days.lab_task: Diagnose four failing requests (a wrong header, a script error, a certificate problem and a timeout) with the console and logs, and write a debugging checklist.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes and a debugging checklist
checks: Each failure has a recorded cause
All four requests succeed after fixes
The checklist covers the steps used

days.topic: Sharing Work: Workspaces, Forks and Version Control
subtopics: Pull requests and merges in Postman
days.lab_task: Fork the team collection, add tests in your fork, open a pull request, review a colleague's pull request and merge both changes without conflicts.
days.deliverable: Merged forks and review comments
checks: Changes are made in a fork
Review comments are added and resolved
Both changes are in the main collection

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Tested Collection for a Booking API
days.lab_task: Build a complete tested collection for a booking API with environments, authorisation, schema checks, negative and data-driven tests and a chained booking flow, and run it in CI with an HTML report.
days.deliverable: Tested collection, environments, data file and CI workflow
checks: Every endpoint has positive and negative tests
The booking flow passes end to end
The collection runs in CI with an HTML report
objectives: Build a complete API test collection

intermediate.summary: For testers and developers who use Postman daily and need automated, maintainable API suites. Covers API test design techniques, contract testing against OpenAPI, reusable scripts with the package library, OAuth 2.0 and JWT flows, CI automation with Newman, monitors, performance runs, microservice APIs, Postman Flows, WebSocket and gRPC, API security checks against the OWASP list, test data, back-end state checks, third-party mocks, reporting, governance rules, Git and secrets with Postman Vault, and AI help with Postbot.
prerequisites: Writes Postman tests with variables, environments and chained requests
Has run a collection with Newman or the Postman CLI
outcomes: Design API test suites with clear coverage of behaviour and contracts
Automate API tests in CI with monitors, reports and safe secrets
Test security, performance and non-REST protocols from Postman
Keep large collections maintainable with shared scripts, reviews and governance

days.topic: Test Design for APIs: Equivalence, Boundaries and State
subtopics: Applying test design techniques to APIs
Boundary values for numbers, strings and dates
days.lab_task: Design tests for an order API using partitions, boundaries, a state transition model and a decision table, implement the highest-value cases and map them to requirements.
days.deliverable: Test design worksheet and implemented tests
checks: The highest-value cases run in Postman

days.topic: Contract Testing with OpenAPI in Postman
subtopics: Validating requests and responses against the definition
Keeping tests and definitions in step
days.lab_task: Link the collection to the API's OpenAPI definition, validate responses against it, introduce a breaking change in a sample and show the contract check failing in CI.
days.deliverable: Contract-validated collection and CI check
checks: Responses are validated against the definition
The breaking change fails the check
Tests and definition are versioned together

days.topic: Reusable Scripts: Package Library and Collection-Level Scripts
days.lab_task: Move repeated assertions and setup into a shared package, use it from three collections with pm.require and change one helper in one place.
days.deliverable: Shared script package used by three collections
checks: One helper change applies to all collections

days.topic: Advanced Authentication: OAuth 2.0 Flows, JWT and Signed Requests
days.lab_task: Configure authorisation code with PKCE and client credentials flows, test token expiry and refresh, check JWT claims in tests and call an endpoint that needs a client certificate.
days.deliverable: Auth flows with claim and certificate tests
checks: Both OAuth flows obtain working tokens
Tests assert roles and expiry in the JWT
The mutual TLS endpoint accepts the configured certificate

days.topic: API Test Automation in CI with Newman and GitHub Actions
subtopics: Running on pull requests and schedules
days.lab_task: Store the collection in Git, run it with Newman in GitHub Actions on pull requests and nightly, split folders into parallel jobs, publish HTML reports and notify the team on failures.
days.deliverable: CI workflow with reports and notifications
checks: The workflow runs on pull requests and nightly
A failure sends a team notification

days.topic: Monitors for Scheduled API Checks
days.lab_task: Create a monitor that runs a smoke collection every hour from two regions, alert the team chat on failures and review a week of results.
days.deliverable: Monitor with alerts and a weekly review
checks: The monitor runs hourly from two regions
A forced failure sends an alert
The weekly review lists failures and causes

days.topic: Performance Testing with the Postman Collection Runner
subtopics: What Postman performance runs can and cannot do
Response time and error rate metrics
Choosing requests for a performance run
When to move to a dedicated load tool
days.lab_task: Run a performance test with a ramp-up profile on three key endpoints, find the slowest endpoint and error threshold, and compare two runs after a configuration change.
days.deliverable: Performance run results and a comparison
checks: The ramp-up profile completes for three endpoints
The slowest endpoint and error threshold are identified
Two runs are compared with conclusions
objectives: Know when to use load tools

days.topic: Testing Microservice APIs and Dependencies
subtopics: Testing services in isolation with mocks
days.lab_task: Test an order flow across three services, isolate one service with a mock of its dependency, poll for an eventually consistent result and check correlation IDs in responses.
days.deliverable: Cross-service and isolated test folders
checks: The order flow passes end to end
The mocked dependency lets one service be tested alone
Polling waits for the result with a timeout

days.topic: Postman Flows for Workflow Testing
subtopics: Using collection requests in a flow
When to use flows or scripts
days.lab_task: Build a flow that creates an order, waits for payment status, branches on the result and posts a summary, then compare it with the same logic written in scripts.
days.deliverable: Working flow and a comparison note
checks: The flow runs from start to summary
Both payment outcomes take the right branch
The note compares flows with scripts for this case

days.topic: Testing WebSocket, gRPC and Server-Sent Events in Postman
days.lab_task: Test a WebSocket chat service by sending and checking messages, call a gRPC service with a protobuf definition including a streaming method and check an error case for each.
days.deliverable: WebSocket and gRPC request sets with checks
checks: Sent and received messages are checked
Unary and streaming calls return expected data
Each protocol has a checked error case

days.topic: API Security Checks Against the OWASP API Security Top 10
days.lab_task: Test a deliberately vulnerable API for object-level authorisation, authentication weaknesses, data exposure and missing rate limits, and write findings with severity and evidence.
days.deliverable: Security test folder and findings report
checks: Another user's object cannot be read or changed
Responses with unnecessary sensitive fields are reported
Missing rate limiting is demonstrated or ruled out

days.topic: Test Data Management for API Suites
subtopics: Data problems as a cause of failures
days.lab_task: Redesign a suite so each run creates its own data, cleans it up even after failures and uses masked reference data, then run two copies in parallel without collisions.
days.deliverable: Data-independent suite with parallel run evidence
checks: Each run creates the data it needs
Data is removed after failures too
Two runs pass at the same time

days.topic: Validating Back-End State Through Helper APIs and Events
subtopics: Helper or admin endpoints for verification
Message queues and their test endpoints
Checking side effects such as emails
Avoiding direct database access from Postman
days.lab_task: Verify that an order creates an audit entry, a queue event and a confirmation email using helper endpoints, and document the test endpoints agreed with developers.
days.deliverable: Side-effect checks and an agreed test-endpoint list
checks: The audit entry exists after the order
The event and email are found
Test endpoints are disabled outside test environments

days.topic: Mocking Third-Party Services and Error Scenarios
subtopics: Mocking payment, SMS and email providers
Switching between real sandboxes and mocks
days.lab_task: Mock a payment provider with success, decline, timeout and rate-limit responses, run the order suite against each case and compare with the provider's sandbox.
days.deliverable: Third-party mock and scenario results
checks: All four provider responses are mocked
The order API handles each case as specified
Mock and sandbox responses are compared

days.topic: Reporting: htmlextra Reports and Test Dashboards
subtopics: Report needs for testers, developers and managers
days.lab_task: Configure htmlextra and JUnit reports, show trends across ten runs in the CI dashboard and post a run summary with failure links to the team chat.
days.deliverable: Report configuration, trend view and chat summary
checks: HTML and JUnit reports are produced
The chat summary links to failures

days.topic: Collaboration: Reviews, Comments and API Governance Rules
subtopics: Naming and style rules for APIs
days.lab_task: Write a review checklist for collections, review a colleague's changes with comments, lint an API definition against style rules and fix the findings.
days.deliverable: Review checklist, review comments and lint results
checks: The definition passes the style rules after fixes
The checklist covers naming, tests and variables

days.topic: Version Control for Collections with Git
subtopics: Why collections belong in version control
Exporting collections and environments to Git
Handling merge conflicts in collection files
Running tests from the repository in CI
Keeping Postman and Git in step
days.lab_task: Put the collection and environments in a Git repository, change tests on a branch, review and merge through a pull request and run the tagged version in CI.
days.deliverable: Versioned collection with a merged pull request
checks: Collection and environments are in the repository
Changes merge through a reviewed pull request
A tagged version runs in CI

days.topic: Postman Vault, Secrets and Safe Sharing
subtopics: Secret scanning in Postman and Git
days.lab_task: Move all credentials into Postman Vault and CI secrets, scan the workspace and repository for leaked secrets, rotate one leaked test credential and write a secrets policy.
days.deliverable: Secret-free collection, scan results and policy
checks: The policy covers storage, sharing and rotation

days.topic: AI Assistance in Postman: Postbot for Tests and Debugging
subtopics: Data privacy when using AI features
days.lab_task: Use Postbot to generate tests for five requests and to fix a broken script, review every generated assertion and record what you kept, changed and removed.
days.deliverable: Reviewed AI-generated tests and a review log
checks: Postbot produces tests for five requests
Weak or wrong assertions are corrected
No confidential data is sent to AI features against policy

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Automated API Regression Pack in CI
days.lab_task: Build an API regression pack for a sample microservice application with designed tests, contract checks, shared scripts, security and negative tests, versioned in Git, running in CI with reports and an hourly monitor.
days.deliverable: Regression pack, CI workflow, monitor and handover notes
checks: Tests trace to requirements and contracts
CI and monitor runs pass and report
A colleague runs and extends the pack from the notes

advanced.summary: For API test leads, SDETs and quality engineers responsible for API quality across many services. Covers API test strategy for platforms, consumer-driven contracts with Pact, moving to code-based tests, performance with k6, security testing in depth, asynchronous and event-driven APIs, governance at scale, service virtualisation, synthetic monitoring, resilience testing, privacy, GraphQL at scale, testing AI and LLM APIs, Postman enterprise administration, metrics, extending Newman, partner APIs, building team skills and troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has built automated API suites with Postman and Newman
outcomes: Set API test strategy across a platform and choose the right tool for each layer
Add contracts, performance, security and resilience testing to API quality
Govern API design and testing across many teams
Lead API testing practice, metrics and capability building

days.topic: API Testing Strategy for Large Platforms
subtopics: Layers: unit, contract, component, integration and end to end
Where Postman fits and where code-based tools fit
Environments and data at platform scale
days.lab_task: Map the APIs of a case platform, rate risk per service, decide test layers and tools for each, and present the strategy to role-played engineering leaders.
days.deliverable: API inventory, risk map and strategy
checks: Every service has its APIs and consumers listed
Each risk has a test layer and tool
Leaders approve the strategy or set conditions

days.topic: Consumer-Driven Contract Testing with Pact Alongside Postman
subtopics: Why schema checks are not enough between teams
days.lab_task: Write Pact consumer tests for a front end calling an order service, verify them on the provider, gate deployment with can-i-deploy and remove duplicated Postman checks.
days.deliverable: Pact contracts, verification and deployment gate
checks: The provider verifies the contract in CI

days.topic: Moving from Postman to Code-Based API Tests: When and How
subtopics: Signs a suite has outgrown Postman
Code-based options: REST Assured, pytest with requests and Playwright API tests
Keeping Postman for exploration and documentation
Measuring the effect of the move
days.lab_task: Port twenty Postman tests to a code-based framework, run both suites for a week and recommend which tests stay in Postman and which move to code.
days.deliverable: Ported tests, comparison and recommendation
checks: Maintenance, speed and ownership are compared
The recommendation splits tests by purpose
objectives: Decide when to move to code

days.topic: API Performance Engineering with k6 and Postman Collections
subtopics: Load, stress, spike and soak tests
Thresholds as pass and fail criteria
Test data and correlation in k6
days.lab_task: Convert a collection to a k6 script, run load and spike tests with thresholds against a sample service, find the bottleneck with monitoring data and add a short run to CI.
days.deliverable: k6 scripts, results analysis and CI step
checks: The bottleneck is identified with monitoring evidence
A threshold breach fails the CI step

days.topic: API Security Testing in Depth: Authorisation, Injection and Abuse Cases
subtopics: Authorisation matrices by role and object
days.lab_task: Threat model an API, build and run an authorisation matrix across roles and objects, test for mass assignment, injection and SSRF, and write findings with reproduction steps.
days.deliverable: Threat model, authorisation matrix tests and findings
checks: Every role and object combination is tested
Findings have severity and reproduction steps

days.deliverable: Asynchronous flow tests and findings
checks: Duplicate events do not create duplicate payments
Failed messages reach the dead-letter queue

days.topic: Governance at Scale: API Linting, Style Rules and Breaking-Change Checks
subtopics: Why governance matters across many teams
days.lab_task: Write an API style rule set, lint five definitions, add breaking-change detection to pull requests and report governance status across teams.
days.deliverable: Rule set, lint results, PR check and status report
checks: All five definitions are linted with results
A breaking change is flagged on a pull request
The status report shows each team's compliance

days.topic: Service Virtualisation and Environments for Many Teams
days.lab_task: Replace an unstable shared dependency with a stateful virtual service, version it, publish it for three teams and compare test stability before and after.
days.deliverable: Virtual service, version policy and stability comparison
checks: The virtual service handles the main flows with state
Teams can pin a virtual service version
Failure rate drops after the change

days.topic: Testing APIs in Production: Synthetic Monitoring and Canary Checks
tools: Postman monitors or a synthetic monitoring tool
days.lab_task: Design safe synthetic checks for a production API with marked test data, add canary checks for a new version and connect alerts to the on-call tool.
days.deliverable: Synthetic checks, canary checks and alert routing
checks: Synthetic data is marked and cleaned
Canary checks compare old and new versions

subtopics: Resilience patterns: timeouts, retries and circuit breakers
days.lab_task: Define a steady state for an order API, inject latency and errors into its dependency, check timeouts, retries and circuit breakers and report the weaknesses found.
days.deliverable: Experiment plan, results and weakness report
checks: Steady-state measures are agreed before the experiment
Latency and errors are injected and observed
Weaknesses have owners and fixes planned

subtopics: GDPR and India's DPDP Act in testing
Logs and reports that leak data

days.deliverable: Privacy audit, clean suite and pipeline check

Testing structure instead of exact text

subtopics: What API quality means to the business
Test suite health: flakiness and duration

days.deliverable: Quality dashboard and leadership briefing
checks: The dashboard shows all five metric groups
Escaped defects are linked to incidents
Leaders receive three findings with actions

days.topic: Extending Newman: Custom Reporters and Pipelines
subtopics: Sending results to databases and dashboards
Dynamic environments and data at run time
days.lab_task: Write a Node.js runner that executes several collections in parallel with Newman, a custom reporter that writes results to a database, and package it for other teams.
days.deliverable: Packaged runner and reporter with documentation
